narration.text: Denied claims, reworked. This is a chore for a three-doctor family practice billing four payers, with one part-time biller. Pull the denial worklist from the practice management system and read each claim's reason code. Athena works it across 3 portals: Practice management, Clearinghouse and Availity. On the bench, she found 9 of 10 eligible items, worth 2,120 dollars of the 2,120 dollars there was to find. All 9 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 22 traps, and she walked past 22. Among them: A timely-filing denial whose only clearinghouse record is a rejection at intake: that is not proof the payer received it. An authorisation denial with no authorisation on file: an appeal would be refused. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 10 hours, so she was about 194 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 30 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
